name: Pocket Village
description: Walk around a tiny generated village. The LLM invents the villagers, their quests and items; the image model draws every sprite and tile; villagers talk back in character when you chat with them.

params.label: Premise
params.default: A cozy mushroom village where the annual Lantern Festival starts tonight, but the festival's golden bell has gone missing.

models.note: Any instruct chat model works; 4B is fast and follows JSON schemas well.
Fast 4B image model with reference/edit support; any image model works.

params.name: premise
params.default: A cozy mushroom village where the annual Lantern Festival starts tonight, but the festival's golden bell has gone missing.

params.style: cute 16-bit pixel art, top-down RPG, soft colours

params.name: Grandma Fern
params.persona: The village elder, a tiny old mushroom lady who knits scarves for everyone and knows every secret. Speaks in warm proverbs. Secretly hid the bell to test the young ones.
params.greeting: Ah, a new face! Sit, sit. Have you eaten?

params.rules: Stay in character. Keep replies under 50 words. Drop gentle hints about quests.

notes.text:
Run, then Play

Run paints the sprites and tiles (about one image per villager, item and tile). Play: WASD or arrows (or click) to walk, E or Space to talk and pick things up, I for inventory. Grandma Fern is hand-written: edit her persona, or add more NPC nodes.
